headline: Binance Responds to $6.3 Billion Crypto Hack with War Room and Asset Recovery
summary: Binance mobilized a 100-person war room involving employees, investigators, blockchain firms, and authorities following a $6.3 billion hack, later stating that 90% of the stolen assets have been replenished.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and major security breaches or fund losses at such platforms can significantly impact crypto market liquidity, user trust, and regulatory scrutiny across the digital asset sector.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Binance is directly impacted by the security breach and subsequent asset recovery efforts.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A multi-billion dollar exploit on a major cryptocurrency exchange threatens systemic market confidence and platform solvency, causing immediate volatility across digital assets.
